info.name: FleetMon API Reference Basic Vessel Data Vessel Change Events API
Delivers change events for a vessels.

params.name: vessel_id
params.description: ID of vessel to get events for

params.name: event_type
params.description: Type of event that should be delivered

params.name: limit
params.description: Limit number of results, <0 means descending order, >0 means ascending order

params.name: request_limit_info
params.description: If `true` some extra attributes will be added to the response informing about usage and limits of this endpoint.

params.name: until
params.description: Start of requested time interval (default: now)

items.docs: Delivers change events for a vessels.
